turns.text: Happy Saturday, Daniel! How is your weekend starting off?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's starting off great. I actually walked down to the neighborhood bakehouse earlier and treated myself to one of those flaky, crescent-shaped French pastries. Still warm from the oven.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, those are the best when they're fresh. Are you relaxing today, or do you have some work to catch up on for the design firm?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I've actually got a big deadline, so I'm doing some catch-up from my desk at home today. Since I don't have to go into the office, I'm wearing a cozy hooded fleece sweatshirt and some matching drawstring sweatpants. Quite a change from my standard collared button-downs and smart chinos!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Working from home definitely has its perks, especially the dress code. It sounds incredibly comfy. How is Leah doing? Is she at the hospital today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She is, actually! Pediatrics has been busy lately, but she's really finding her groove there. She's also loving that pottery class she started.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful to hear. She's really settling into Chicago life. Speaking of food, any big plans for dinner tonight once you both wrap up your work?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, yes. I'm planning to sear a couple of thick, high-quality cuts of ribeye beef in the cast-iron skillet tonight. Leah's looking forward to it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A nice seared beef ribeye sounds like the perfect reward after a busy Saturday of working from home. Do you usually cook a lot of meat at home, or do you tend to mix it up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We definitely mix it up, but as an omnivore, I really appreciate a good piece of meat now and then. We do our fair share of veggies and grains too, but tonight is all about that beef.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious. How has your wrist been feeling lately? Are you fully back to your usual activities, maybe even checking out that new climbing gym across town?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The wrist is perfect, completely healed up. I haven't made it to the new gym across town yet, but I've been taking some local photos around Chicago whenever I get a free afternoon.
